notes: Authoritative record of the upstream versions hermes-odd supports. sha256 values hash the file content at pinned_commit (git show <commit>:<path> | shasum -a 256). Human triage of upstream changes lives in upstream/SUPPORTED.md.

gentle-ai.release_note: Supported release v4.0.0 ("SDD Retires, ODD Leads, Module Path Moves to /v4", tag ff77164d); the pin is main at 5140c5f5, 3 commits after the tag (T15 re-pin, 34 commits after d96a5d4; triage in upstream/SUPPORTED.md). Ported in T15: the evidence-budget delegation rules (991c3d06), the only change to RenderRouting(model.AgentHermes) and to the Hermes orchestrator asset; the Hermes-managed SOUL block names and markers are unchanged. Earlier: SDD retired (e219644b), applicable test-first (55e3abf1), receipt-driven development limited to runtimes with a native review transport (5ffb65fc; Hermes gets ODD only). The binary minimum stays 3.7.0 because hermes-odd only runs the `gentle-ai version` probe, whose output format v4.0.0 keeps; v4.0.0 is tested.

binary.name: gentle-ai
binary.used_for: the read-only `gentle-ai version` probe of /odd-status and /odd-doctor; never `gentle-ai install` or `gentle-ai sync` for Hermes

gentle-shell.release_note: Pinned 6 commits after the v4.0.0 tag (package.json 4.0.0); T15 triaged the 90 commits after 4d2c3f5 in upstream/SUPPORTED.md (ported: the evidence budget 14bd2356, the project-root boundary e2d85a47 as guidance, the localized single-PR option 2843a599). gentle-pi 4.0.0 pins the gentle-ai 4.0.0 binary (scripts/gentle-ai-installer.mjs INSTALLER_VERSION).

odd.description: Compact always-on ODD prompt section and the lazy odd-* skills; canonical gentle-ai routing render for Hermes vendored for drift comparison.
odd.port_notes: T11: the default applicable test-first policy (gentle-ai 55e3abf1/f2cecbae, gentle-shell a76e6f2/80375c6) replaces the configured TDD mode in the prompt section step 6, hermes-odd:odd-workflow section 6 and the odd-delegation mission template; the setup TDD choice is retired. From the ODD-only Hermes orchestrator (internal/assets/hermes/orchestrator.md with the (ODD only) shared sections, fb4b59a7/1ba7d888/5ffb65fc) hermes-odd ports, in its own words, the risk-proportionate Delegated Verification Gate (odd-delegation section 3), the checking rules (normalize before checks, one quick check, one scoped correction, needs-your-decision; odd-workflow section 6), one launch per distinct task and the parent-selected memory context. Not ported: the Provider Defect Handoff (removed for non-RDD runtimes), the plain-chat-only blocking prompt route (hermes-odd uses clarify, verified), the claim that children inherit no toolsets (verified wrong for current Hermes) and the ~/.hermes/skills skill-path scan (hermes-odd passes qualified skill_view names). T15: the evidence budget (gentle-ai 991c3d06, gentle-shell 14bd2356) replaces the 1-3 / 4+ file counts and the ~20 tool call backstop in the prompt section and hermes-odd:odd-workflow: one inline batch of at most 3 calls and ~10k tokens, a read-only explorer child returning at most ~2k tokens with path:line evidence, an advisory ~150k parent-context backstop and bounded shell output. The project-root boundary of gentle-shell e2d85a47 is stated as guidance (Hermes has no guard hook); a code review never replaces functional checks (8cc8eb03).

rdd.description: Receipt-driven development was removed from hermes-odd in T13: upstream (gentle-ai 5ffb65fc) limits RDD to runtimes with a native review transport (claude-code, codex, opencode, pi); Hermes is excluded by design. The /odd-review-mode command, the rdd-review skill and the native review probes were deleted. The advisory 4R review lenses (skills/advisory-review-lenses) and judgment-day remain as advisory review, clearly labeled as receipt-less.
rdd.port_notes: T7 ported the RDD surface (status, enable, disable, honest protocol, advisory 4R). T8 blocked: upstream excludes Hermes. T13 removed the RDD surface entirely: /odd-review-mode, rdd-review skill, native review probes, RDD checks in doctor/status. Advisory review lenses renamed from rdd-review-lenses to advisory-review-lenses.

review-contract.description: Versions of the gentle-ai review CLI contract and of the provider contract mirror that the odd_review facade will speak.
review-contract.capability_note: In gentle-ai v3.7.0 capabilitymanifest the hermes adapter's reviewTransportV1 and immutableReviewExecutorV1 exposures are dormant (ContractReviewTransportV1 / ContractImmutableReviewExecutorV1 are advertised only for claude-code, opencode, codex, pi: runtimes that can launch a fresh, constrained reviewer and prove that boundary before review START). Verified against the gentle-ai 3.7.0 binary (2026-09-25): `gentle-ai review status --cwd <repo> --contract gentle-ai.review-integration/v2 --agent hermes --next-transition` fails in preflight with schema gentle-ai.review-integration.failure/v2, code immutable_review_transport_unsupported, next_action stop, mutation_outcome not_started. The cause lists the runtimes eligible in the probing environment (internal/cli/review_transport_capability.go: pi only with its host relay handshake, opencode only on a V1 runtime), a subset of the compiled set. hermes-odd never passes another runtime's identity; the facade (T8) is blocked on upstream eligibility. Re-checked at gentle-ai a9e36e9 (T11): manifest.go and review_transport_capability.go are byte-identical to v3.7.0, and internal/model/rdd.go (5ffb65fc) makes the same four runtimes the only RDD runtimes, with a parity test (agentguidance/rdd_gating_test.go) tying it to the manifest.

viewers.description: Plain-text viewer and health commands: /odd_agents, /odd_tasks, /odd_changes (Viewers) and /odd_status, /odd_doctor, /odd_commands (Health).
viewers.port_notes: /odd_agents (T3) is a concept port of the gentle-shell Gentle Agents TaskRecord model (extensions/gentle-agents.ts, lib/agents-protocol.ts, lib/agents-view.ts, docs/gentle-agents-activity.md): no upstream code or text is copied, so it carries no derived-from marker. The Pi card, widget and RPC activity transport are not ported. /odd_tasks (T4) is a concept port of the gentle-shell todo card (extensions/gentle-todo.ts, lib/shell-todo.ts) plus the ODD feature document view: it reads odd/tasks/*.md directly and renders plain text; no upstream code or text is copied. The interactive Pi todo tool is not ported: Hermes' native todo tool is used instead. /odd_changes (T5) is a concept port of gentle-shell Gentle Changes (lib/session-changes.ts capture model, lib/shell-changes-view.ts, the Gentle Changes sections of README.md and docs/gentle-shell.md): successful write_file/patch calls captured from Hermes' post_tool_call hook, attributed to main or the subagent, with line counts computed at capture time and no stored content; no upstream code or text is copied. The two-pane diff viewer and before/after snapshots are not ported (Pi TUI; hermes-odd keeps no file content). /odd_status and /odd_doctor (T6) are concept ports of gentle-pi's gentle:status and gentle:doctor (extensions/gentle-ai.ts): one compact status message and a read-only check list with pass/warn/fail marks and remedies, rebuilt for Hermes (gentle-ai binaries on PATH against the lock minimum, RDD mode via `gentle-ai review mode status --json`, SOUL.md size, gentle-ai managed blocks and Hermes' truncation cap, the plugin's own surface, the upstream lock, Hermes); no upstream code or text is copied. The Pi-specific checks (package assets, OpenSpec config, skill registry, model routing, dev binary) are not ported. The RDD mode wording follows gentle-ai's `receipt-driven development: <mode> (decided by <source>)`; the RDD sidebar lifecycle labels of lib/review-sidebar-state.ts (2ac9c68, 8becfd8) describe review lineages and are left for the odd_review facade (T8).

persona.description: First-run setup over chat (the gentle-ai installer's persona step, rebuilt for Hermes): skill hermes-odd:setup (one clarify call), /odd_setup, tool odd_setup_apply, plugin config_schema, and one hermes-odd persona block at the top of SOUL.md with backup and explicit confirmation.
persona.port_notes: T9a: persona texts are hermes-odd's own wording of the upstream behavior rules (no AI attribution in commits, short answers by default, one question at a time, no option menus without a real fork, verify before agreeing, explain why with evidence, alternatives with tradeoffs, persona scope limited to chat with artifacts in English, reply in the user's language, caring and direct mentor tone, concepts before code; Rioplatense voseo or neutral Spanish). Excluded: the '## Identity' product identity, branding, author biography, tool preferences (editor and terminal multiplexers), the Hermes skill-loading and Engram memory sections (Hermes and the T9b Engram skill cover them). Installer presets, component selection and model pickers are not portable (see upstream/SUPPORTED.md). The SOUL cleanup of gentle-ai blocks and the lazy Engram protocol skill shipped with T9b (component soul-cleanup).

soul-cleanup.description: Explicit, dry-run-first cleanup of the gentle-ai managed blocks in SOUL.md (/odd_soul, tool odd_soul_apply) and the lazy skills that replace the moved blocks (hermes-odd:engram-protocol, hermes-odd:codegraph), pointed to by one prompt-section line each.
soul-cleanup.port_notes: T9b: the Engram protocol (full variant of internal/assets/engram/protocol.md) and the CodeGraph guidance (CodeGraphGuidanceMarkdown in codegraph_guidance.go) are condensed in hermes-odd's own words and bound to Hermes tool names (mcp__engram__*, mcp__codegraph__*, terminal); `gentle-ai codegraph init --cwd <root>` becomes the upstream CLI `codegraph init <root>` (verified with codegraph 1.2.0 --help). Not ported: the slim, passive-capture and compact variants of protocol.md (Hermes has no compaction hook for them) and the workflow-artifact prompt-capture examples. The cleanup itself is a concept port with no upstream text: sdd-orchestrator (with its nested sdd-session-preflight) and agent-routing are removed, engram-protocol and codegraph-guidance move to the skills, persona and unknown blocks stay; the remote-authorization block that InjectRoutingWithOptions (inject.go) nests inside agent-routing through InjectRemoteAuthorization (remote_authorization.go, contract generic/remote-authorization-contract.md) is lifted byte-identical, with its gentle-ai markers, into agent-routing's place. T11: a gentle-ai install after fb4b59a7 writes the ODD-only Hermes orchestrator as a top-level `orchestrator` block right before agent-routing and renames a v3.7.0 sdd-orchestrator block to it (agentguidance/orchestrator.go injectOrchestratorSection, migrateLegacyOrchestratorSection; inject.go InjectRoutingWithOptions); /odd_soul removes it like sdd-orchestrator. The legacy strict-tdd-mode block that v3.7.0 wrote with strict TDD on is retired by gentle-ai itself (strict_tdd.go, enabled=false) and stays kept as an unknown block.

portable-skills.description: Portable gentle-ai workflow skills rebuilt for Hermes: hermes-odd:judgment-day (blind dual review, advisory), hermes-odd:work-unit-commits (ODD commit closure) and hermes-odd:chained-pr (400-line review budget, delivery and chain strategies).
portable-skills.port_notes: T10: behavior-only ports in hermes-odd's own words; no upstream skill text is copied. The upstream skill files declare `license: Apache-2.0` in their frontmatter while both upstream repositories are MIT-licensed (LICENSE), so hermes-odd carries over behavior only and credits the MIT notices (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Bound to Hermes: delegate_task (two blind read-only judges, one bounded fixer), clarify (one question before any fix; the chain strategy), terminal (git, gh), skill_view with qualified hermes-odd:<name> names (bare same-named skills in ~/.hermes/skills may carry workflows hermes-odd does not ship). Judgment-day is advisory (no receipt, no delivery authority) and replaces the advisory 4R of rdd-review for its target; findings reuse the rdd-review-lenses block. The commit and delivery rules moved out of skills/odd-workflow section 7 so each rule lives in one skill (routing.go is the shared source). The gentle-shell copies (skills/judgment-day, skills/work-unit-commits, skills/chained-pr) are not indexed; the default-branch check of gentle-shell 4014403 is restated in chained-pr. T15: chained-pr asks the oversized delivery menu of gentle-shell 2843a599 (assets/orchestrator-delegation.md, indexed here): feature-branch chain, stacked PRs to the verified default branch, one single PR least recommended, in the user's language; size exceptions follow the destination repository's policy.

gentle-ai: SDD skills, agents, commands and preflight assets
excluded.reason: hermes-odd ships no SDD in any form (agents, chains, skills, preflight, prompts, gentle-sdd-* commands).
Themes, banners, animations, TUI widgets, keyboard shortcuts and double-esc cancel are Pi terminal UI; Hermes commands answer as plain text on every gateway.

Dev binary, bundled gentle-ai download, telemetry, Pi model profiles and routing, Pi package installers and the Pi in-process reviewer host are Pi-specific; hermes-odd uses the user's installed gentle-ai binary and Hermes' own delegate_task.

They write their orchestrator, routing and guidance blocks into ~/.hermes/SOUL.md (SDD-heavy at v3.7.0, an ODD-only orchestrator after fb4b59a7), which Hermes truncates; hermes-odd replaces them with a compact prompt section and lazy skills.
Upstream's own test runners, benchmarks, feature documents and CI do not ship to users.
